subject.title: fix(agents): keep sender-scoped tools in delegated runs

question: Should verified persisted child lineage and the private `subagent_announce` completion handoff be approved as authority-bearing inputs for retaining the originating requester's effective tool policy across all routed tool surfaces?
rationale: The patch is designed to preserve existing authority rather than widen public RPC access, but accepting the exact lineage/provenance trust boundary is a security-sensitive product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical review conclusion.

options.title: Approve the bounded inheritance model
options.body: Confirm that persisted spawned lineage plus the private completion handoff are the intended authority boundary, then merge after the normal exact-head gates complete.

options.title: Narrow the trusted sources further
options.body: Require a more restrictive provenance or session-store contract before merge if any accepted internal route can be reached by an untrusted caller.

options.title: Pause for a broader policy design
options.body: Defer the PR if maintainers want sender-policy inheritance to be specified as a wider authorization model before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded inheritance model
recommendation.body: Confirm that persisted spawned lineage plus the private completion handoff are the intended authority boundary, then merge after the normal exact-head gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most concrete current-release evidence for the completion-fallback path and are already engaged on the adjacent session behavior.
